description:
What this is. Enrolling is done from the employee, not from a separate record. It sends the person down to the machines you choose and holds the fingerprints captured for each one, so their scans start counting.

What to do. Open the employee and use Biometric Device › Add to Device, then pick the machines they should be on. If their fingerprints change later, Update on Device pushes the new ones out.

Where to find it. Employee, under HR.
name: Enrol a Biometric User
title: Employee — enrol their fingerprints
